decisions.reason: As a multi-model safety shoe line in the firm's core business, it carries substantial development and production commitment, so management would usually continue rather than reverse course in 2025.
The comfort insole is a more peripheral accessory, but it complements the footwear system and prior launch investment still makes continued support more likely than withdrawal.
The supportive insole remains one of the easier items to rationalize, yet sunk costs and its functional fit with the firm's shoe offering still favor keeping it on the market.
An ergonomic safety shoe series with its own page reflects visible commitment in a central category, which strongly reinforces persistence under escalation of commitment.

Firefighter and rescue boots are specialized but still close to the firm's protective-footwear core, so management would typically keep the line and attribute any weaker results to market-development timing.
Because the moulded insole was presented as a flagship focus of the firm's direction, public and strategic commitment makes withdrawal in the coming year very unlikely.
